minutes.headline: APDC discussed merging with the Historical Commission and the Town Hall and Ritter building projects; no votes except adjournment.
minutes.summary: The chair reported on the Select Board's skeptical reaction to merging the commission with the Historical Commission and on awaiting legal input from Adam Costa. He also described touring Town Hall and the Ritter building with the architect, and the bid situation for exterior repairs and windows at the Ritter building. The Brooks House, 50 Main Street church steeple, and next meeting date were also discussed. The only vote was adjournment.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked a person who joined late for public comment; they were on mute and no comment was heard.

budget_items.topic: PAC (performing arts group) funds toward Town Hall project
budget_items.what_was_said: The chair noted the group has a sum in its bank account it could put toward the project.
The exterior repairs package came in as a low bid; the chair said the contractor was being asked whether it could hold that price, and otherwise the work might go back to Town Meeting in May.
The windows bid came in far higher; the chair said the Town Manager told the Select Board the town cannot afford the windows.

budget_items.topic: T-Mobile battery in Town Hall attic
budget_items.what_was_said: A large lithium battery is reportedly to be brought up to the attic, raising fire-code questions.
The contractor asked to substitute architectural shingles for the three-tab shingles in the specs; the chair said they cost more but last longer.
The Town Manager chose not to go out to bid for the handicap ramp, given a possible project that would add an elevator.

transfers.description: The chair suggested using the money in the window replacement line for the exterior repairs.

decisions.decision: Property owner notification and brochure for APD owners are deferred until Adam Costa's input on the merger is received.
The chair will contact Nathan and draft a letter about the 50 Main Street church for review in January.
Next meeting proposed for 9 January 2025; no objection heard.
The chair will ask the Municipal Building Design Committee to hand the Brooks House back to the Town Manager.

what_happened.line: The commission held no votes except adjournment; the chair reported on the proposed merger with the Historical Commission, with the Select Board's reaction described as skeptical.
Property owner notification and a brochure for district owners were deferred until legal input on the merger arrives from Adam Costa.
The Ritter building exterior repairs bid came in low, while the windows bid came in far higher; the chair said the Town Manager told the Select Board the town cannot afford the windows.
The chair will ask the Municipal Building Design Committee to hand the Brooks House back to the Town Manager, and will draft a letter on the 50 Main Street church for January.
The next meeting was proposed for 9 January 2025, with no objection heard.

why_it_matters: Whether the commission merges with the Historical Commission would change who reviews exterior changes to buildings in the Architectural Preservation District, which touches owners there.
Ritter windows and exterior repairs are capital spending that may return to Town Meeting in May, so residents could be asked to vote on the work.
watch_next: Adam Costa's input on the merger, which gates owner notification and the brochure.
The 9 January 2025 meeting, and any Ritter exterior repairs article for May Town Meeting.
